@@@ case 33 (planted in a copy of a file of the tree)
import { PENDING_TASKS } from "./pending-tasks";

/**
 * Runs a task, its failure handed to `onFailure`.
 *
 * @kind procedure
 * @param task - the work to run
 * @param onFailure - called with the error when the task fails
 * @returns once the task is done or its failure handled
 * @see docs/backlog/stories/E15-F15-US-036-import-choose-and-embed-a-font.md
 */
async function runSettled(
  task: () => Promise<void>,
  onFailure: (error: unknown) => void,
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await task();
  } catch (error: unknown) {
    onFailure(error);
    throw error;
  }
}

/**
 * Runs an asynchronous task started by an event listener, which returns nothing and cannot await
 * it — a font file read, the fonts the browser lists (US-036): the task's promise is kept with the
 * page's pending tasks (`PENDING_TASKS`), never left floating, and its failure handed to
 * `onFailure`.
 *
 * @kind procedure
 * @param document - page document
 * @param task - the task to run
 * @param onFailure - called with the error when the task fails
 * @see docs/backlog/stories/E15-F15-US-036-import-choose-and-embed-a-font.md
 */
export function runTask(
  document: Document,
  task: () => Promise<void>,
  onFailure: (error: unknown) => void,
): void {
  const running = runSettled(task, onFailure);

  PENDING_TASKS.set(document, [...(PENDING_TASKS.get(document) ?? []), running]);
}

@@@ case 34 (written for a branch the documented cases leave)
/**
 * Rejects in places.
 */
function places(a: boolean, list: number[]) {
  if (a) { return Promise.reject(new Error("a")); }
  for (const each of list) { reject(each); }
  while (a) { Promise.reject(1); }
  do { reject(2); } while (a);
  for (;;) { reject(3); }
  for (const each in list) { reject(4); }
  label: reject(5);
  switch (a) { case true: reject(6); }
  try { a; } catch { reject(7); } finally { reject(8); }
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { reject(9); });
}

/**
 * Inner async.
 */
function outer() {
  async function inner() { throw new Error("x"); }
}
/**
 * Async throwing in a loop.
 */
async function looping(list: number[]) {
  for (const each of list) { throw new Error("x"); }
}
/**
 * Arrow returning a rejection.
 */
const arrow = () => Promise.reject(1);
/**
 * Executor as a function.
 */
function executor() {
  return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) { reject(1); });
}
/**
 * Statement of a function.
 */
async function statement() {
  (function () { throw new Error("x"); });
}

 * Documented.
 *
 * @rejects when it fails
 */
async function documented() { throw new Error("x"); }
